verdict_semantics.target: the exact mathematical conclusion of each registered main declaration
verdict_semantics.proved: the strict SFT translation of the complete conclusion has a positive receipt-backed dependency trace
verdict_semantics.disproved: an existing model-admitted SFT result forces the held denial of at least one logically necessary component of the strict translation
verdict_semantics.strict_translation: preserve quantifiers, carrier type, operators, comparison, resource measure and generality; do not replace the theorem by a weaker finite analogue

rows.title: Sharp Cohn-Elkies sphere-packing asymptotics
rows.necessary_component: The conclusion packages completed real-valued dimension limits and existential completed error functions from generated dimensions to real scalars.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT admits only generated finite succession and exact rational convergence certificates; it explicitly denies completed infinity, an ungenerated continuum and completed real error functions as proof objects.

rows.title: Strict improvement over the MRRW binary-code bound
rows.necessary_component: The strict inequality compares two completed real asymptotic-rate scalars, one defined by a real limsup and the other by real infimum, square-root and logarithmic operations.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT coding/packing closes exact finite code maxima, while its limit law denies a completed real limsup object and requires generated rational enclosures instead.

rows.title: Strict hierarchy of improved spherical-code bounds
rows.necessary_component: The conclusion asserts an all-level hierarchy of completed real rate infima and localized real envelopes over an unbounded natural index.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT preserves each generated finite code/packing census but denies the completed real hierarchy and ungenerated total range required by the exact conclusion.

rows.title: Existence of a finitely presented non-sofic group
rows.necessary_component: The existential witness must be a group that is not sofic.
rows.forced_sft_denial: Every SFT group carrier is generated and finite. Its exact left-regular permutation action is multiplicative with zero error, and every nonidentity element moves every carrier point, giving normalized separation One. Hence every SFT group has a sofic permutation model and no SFT non-sofic witness exists.

rows.title: Infinitely many nonisomorphic property-(T) ICC groups with isomorphic factors
rows.necessary_component: The witness requires an infinite group, an infinite natural-indexed family, infinite conjugacy classes and complex Hilbert/operator-algebra factors.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT group carriers and operator supports are generated finite objects; completed infinite carriers, an all-natural completed family, continuum Hilbert support and complex proof scalars are denied. The IsICC field alone requires Infinite G and therefore directly contradicts the SFT carrier law.

rows.title: Permanent lower bounds for rational formulas with division
rows.necessary_component: The exact proposition fixes formulas over the complex field, fraction-ring evaluation with subtraction and division, and a real logarithmic resource scalar.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT exact operations deny imaginary and negative proof quantities and do not identify a conventional complex fraction-ring formula with a native Fold circuit. Its existing lower-bound law is explicitly confined to admitted Fold edges; other gate bases require a transport theorem. Strict translation therefore forces denial of the exact carrier-and-resource proposition rather than a weakened native analogue.

rows.title: Uniform exponential quantum parallel repetition
rows.necessary_component: The existential constant and universal bound use real suprema of strategies built from complex density matrices and POVMs, followed by a negative real exponential.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT entanglement is exact finite nonfactorable word support and expressly contains no imported complex amplitudes or Hilbert-space axiom. SFT parallel complexity retains a finite resource vector rather than the completed real strategy-value/exponential object required here.

rows.title: Polynomial-factor NP-hardness of the closest-vector problem
rows.necessary_component: The hardness predicate quantifies over the completed family of all bit languages and requires conventional polynomial-time reductions into signed integer lattices with a real 1/400 power gap.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT admits a completeness or hardness transfer only after a total registered verdict- and resource-preserving map covers every declared source instance. It denies a completed unregistered problem family, signed/irrational proof scalars and untransported conventional complexity authority. The exact IsNPHardPromise conclusion therefore receives the denial orientation.

rows.title: Sharp Ehrhart volume inequality
rows.necessary_component: The proposition ranges over arbitrary subsets of a real continuum, uses topological interior and compactness, Lebesgue integration/volume and numerical-zero barycenter and lattice points.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT convexity and lattice geometry are exact finite generated hulls; integration is exact only over finite support; continuum measure and numerical zero are denied proof objects. A finite-polytope enclosure theorem would be a different proposition, so strict translation forces denial of this exact set-and-volume conclusion.

rows.title: Explicit superexponential lower bound for multicolour triangle Ramsey numbers
rows.necessary_component: The conjunction includes a completed Tendsto-atTop divergence statement and an all-colour real bound using exponential, logarithmic and fractional-power scalars.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT Ramsey forcing closes only declared finite colouring censuses, and its limit law denies the completed atTop object. Since the advertised theorem is a conjunction, denial of its necessary Tendsto field disproves the complete conclusion even though individual finite Ramsey censuses remain lawful.

rows.title: Quantitative counterexample to the Erdos-Simonovits compactness conjecture
rows.necessary_component: The existential package requires eventually-atTop real lower bounds, an all-size real power bound and a compactness predicate itself defined by completed eventual asymptotics.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT extremal graph laws close exact finite host/family censuses. The completed eventual filter and unrestricted real fractional-power comparison required by the exact witness package are denied by the SFT limit and exact-operation laws. One failed required conjunct denies the entire existential package.

rows.title: Quantitative counterexample for two-degenerate bipartite graphs
rows.necessary_component: The witness package requires positive real c and epsilon and a completed eventually-atTop lower bound with a real fractional exponent.
rows.forced_sft_denial: SFT admits each finite graph, colouring and extremal census, but denies the completed eventual filter and ungenerated real exponent as proof objects. Because that asymptotic certificate is a required existential field, the exact package has no SFT witness.
